title: Make diff-scoped mutation campaigns exhaustive, preflighted, and evidence-efficient

outcomes.statement: A cold diff-scoped mutation campaign runs every selected shard sequentially and returns one deterministic non-zero summary listing every failed shard and failure stage.
outcomes.demo: Exercise a fixture with multiple independently failing shards and verify that every shard runs, each sandbox is cleaned up, and the final aggregate names all failures and stages.

outcomes.statement: Mutation prerequisites are checked by pnpm check before the authoritative campaign begins.
outcomes.demo: Run pnpm check against fixtures with broken accountable routes, database templates, zero-mutant seams, and adapter or generated-config inputs, and verify each defect fails in the non-campaign preflight.

outcomes.statement: The preflight reports its calculated shard count without rejecting an immutable approved readiness payload when the count differs from expected_mutation_shards.
outcomes.demo: Use a readiness fixture whose expected_mutation_shards differs from the calculated count and verify preflight succeeds with a report, while the story records a timestamped deviation and mutation_shards_actual in actuals.

outcomes.statement: Each story uses one final evidence commit, with timestamped feedback events as its detailed execution record; preview shard selection remains available and never emits test_report.
outcomes.demo: Run a selected-shard preview and verify it produces no test_report, then inspect the documented closure flow and one final evidence commit containing the campaign actuals and timestamped events.

uncertainties.statement: Whether continuing after failures can preserve per-shard database cleanup and signal interruption semantics.
uncertainties.resolution: Wrap each shard in its own catch and finally boundary, aggregate ordinary failures, retain immediate SIGINT and SIGTERM shutdown, and keep campaign-level final cleanup as a last safeguard.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the shard count can authorize or invalidate an already approved readiness payload.
uncertainties.resolution: It cannot. Preflight reports the calculated count; a mismatch produces a timestamped deviation feedback event, and completion records mutation_shards_actual so calibration learns from the observation.

uncertainties.statement: Whether preview shard selection would be lost when the full campaign becomes exhaustive.
uncertainties.resolution: Retain an explicit shard selector for preview runs. A preview is non-authoritative and never emits test_report; the final cold campaign runs the complete calculated shard set.
